entities.summary: John, also known as John the Sanguinary, was a Byzantine general under Justinian I and took active part in the Gothic War (535–554) against the Ostrogoths (Goths). He was the nephew of the rebel Vitalian and later in his life, he was married to Justina, the daughter of Justinian's cousin Germanus.
